filterName: GMX Measurement Only Word Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `MeasurementOnlyTextUnitWordCount` category — the word count from measurement-only text units. Each text unit's source is tokenised and a unit qualifies as measurement-only based on its `DATE`, `TIME`, and `CURRENCY` tokens; units that also contain other content contribute zero, after which the count is taken over the `DATE`, `TIME`, and `CURRENCY` tokens. Counts are stored as GMX-V metrics annotations on segments, text containers, and aggregate resources for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the word-count variant; a companion step counts characters for the same category.
processingNotes: Qualification keys on the `DATE`, `TIME`, and `CURRENCY` token kinds; a unit containing other non-whitespace content yields zero.
Counts are computed over the source content; only translatable text units are counted.
For locales the GMX-V spec treats as logographic, the word count is derived from the character count divided by the per-language factor rather than from token counts.
